EnglishInfo.Description: Apartment Le Hameau de Clotaire B49 is a modern 4-room apartment in Alpe d’Huez, suitable for up to 6 people. The apartment has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and two separate toilets. Two bedrooms are furnished with a double bed, and the third bedroom has two single beds. The living room includes a sitting and dining area and opens onto a balcony with outdoor furniture. The fully equipped kitchen features a fridge with freezer compartment, hotplate, oven, microwave, coffee machine, kettle, toaster, and dishwasher. The apartment is located on the edge of the centre, directly on the ski slopes, with ski lift access at approximately 0 metres. Shops and restaurants are within walking distance. Guests have access to shared facilities such as an indoor heated swimming pool, spa area with sauna and jacuzzi, and a gym.
EnglishInfo.Name: Le Hameau de Clotaire B49
